title: Preparing Youth to Launch into Adulthood
cardText: For teens and young adults preparing to launch — healthy relationships, academic and career direction, and a future aligned with their values.
whatThisFeelsLike: [DRAFT — Matthew to rewrite in his own words] Your son or daughter is standing at the edge of adulthood, and you're not sure they're ready — or maybe you're the one standing there yourself, unsure which direction to go.
howWeWork: For the young man or woman searching for healthy relationships, academic and career focus, and aligning those with their values and beliefs, sessions prepare them for launching into a future filled with joy and purpose. Using CBT, and faith-based integration if the family wants it, the work is practical and forward-looking rather than a diagnosis-driven process. Available in person in West Chester or by telehealth anywhere in Ohio.
